questions.q: Match each flowchart symbol to what it is used for.
pairs: The start or the end of the algorithm
A process, such as a calculation
A decision, with two routes out
The order the steps are carried out in
questions.feedback: The diamond is the one with two ways out, which is what makes it a decision.
questions.revisitLabel: 2.1 Lesson 4 — Flowchart factory, station 1: The five symbols

questions.q: A flowchart has an arrow going back from a decision to an earlier step. What does this show?
questions.feedback: An arrow going backwards is iteration: the steps between will run again.
